item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Chalkboard Outside The Café

turns.text: Add a little pavement chalkboard outside this café saying “COFFEE TO GO”. Make it look like it's really standing there, not a caption on the photo. Keep the wide shot and everything else as it is.

item.tests: Tests exact words integrated into a plausible physical sign rather than a flat photo overlay.

answer_sheet.Sign wording and language: COFFEE TO GO — English, uppercase, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Sign type and placement: A small freestanding pavement chalkboard outside the café, positioned naturally without blocking the entrance.
answer_sheet.Picture and output size: Use cafe-storefront.jpg, keep its wide 16:9 framing; free-tier image size is fine.
answer_sheet.Other edits: Keep the café, striped awning, and outdoor tables unchanged apart from the added sign and its natural shadow.

must_haves: A small freestanding chalkboard is visibly standing on the pavement outside the supplied café.
The chalkboard reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', with all words legible.
The words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective, not floating over the photograph.
The sign has plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, and shadow.
The original storefront, striped awning, outdoor tables, and wide composition remain intact.

style.prompt: Make one small localized addition to the supplied café photograph: add a small freestanding wooden A-frame pavement chalkboard on the pavement outside the café, positioned just to the right of the central entrance and clear of the doorway, realistically scaled smaller than the café tables. Its dark matte chalkboard face must have clearly legible white hand-lettered chalk text exactly: "COFFEE TO GO". It is a physical three-dimensional sandwich-board sign standing on the ground, with visible wooden frame, legs, slight perspective angle, natural contact shadow and lighting matching the scene; not a caption, overlay, or text floating on the photo. Preserve the original wide shot, full composition, camera angle, aspect ratio, storefront, striped awning, doors, windows, all existing tables and chairs, planter, pavement and every other detail as closely as possible. Do not crop or zoom. Change nothing except adding this small realistic sign.
